description: Real IRSA cutouts; bundled display subsets retain IMAGE, FLAGS, VARIANCE and WCS-WAVE. PSF and ZODI are omitted. Original source URLs are retained.

comparisonSelection.method: Selected from successfully retrieved D2 metadata with center wavelengths between 1.17 and 1.59 microns and at least 180 days separation. This is center-only screening, not full-field wavelength/PSF/background matching.
